links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to refractive surgery FAQs using 5 readability indexes
links.effect: All LLM chatbots were very difficult to read and required a university degree.
links.quote: In terms of readability, it was observed that all LLM chatbots were very difficult to read and required a university degree.

links.outcome: Appropriateness of chatbot answers to 40 patient FAQs, rated by two refractive surgeons
links.effect: Correct answers: ChatGPT 3.5 45% (n=18), ChatGPT 4.0 52.5% (n=21), Gemini 87.5% (n=35), Copilot 60% (n=24).
links.quote: Based on the responses generated by the LLM chatbots, 45% (n=18) of the answers given by ChatGPT 3.5 were correct, while this rate was 52.5% (n=21) for ChatGPT 4.0, 87.5% (n=35) for Gemini, and 60% (n=24) for Copilot.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and accuracy of several commercial LLM chatbots answering patient FAQs regarding refractive surgery without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
